articles.summary: Southside Bancshares, Inc. (“Southside”) (NYSE: SBSI), the holding company for Southside Bank, announced today it will release its third quarter financial results before the market opens on Thursday, October 29, 2026. Southside will host a conference call to discuss its results on Thursday, October 29, 2026, at 11:00 a.m. CDT. The call will be hosted by Keith Donahoe, President and Chief Executive Officer, Julie Shamburger, Chief Financial Officer, Suni Davis, Chief Treasury Officer and Lindsey Bailes, SVP, Investor Relations. Following prepared remarks there will be a question and answer session for the analyst community. The Conference Call Details The conference call can be accessed by webcast, for listen-only mode, here or on the company website, https://investors.southside.com , under Events.
